  "title": "Remove email in \"password sent\" URL (reduce personal data)",
  "body": "We're mentioning the email address on the success screen after using the \"lost password\" form. That means email addresses (personal data) is stored in web server logs, referers etc - that's making it harder to comply to regulations like GDPR. We should remove this email data from the URL, either into PHP sessions or (preferrably) by just not requiring this info on the screen.\r\n\r\nSee https://github.com/silverstripe/silverstripe-framework/issues/7791 for context\r\n\r\nPRs:\r\n\r\n * [x] https://github.com/silverstripe/silverstripe-framework/pull/8223\r\n * [x] https://github.com/silverstripe/silverstripe-admin/pull/561",

      "created_at": "2018-06-20T19:59:54Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "I think we should remove the email address altogether. It currently doesn't help that much, and most sites don't use it (instead just having a standard message like \"We have sent you a password reset email, if an account existed with that address\" in all situations)."
    },
    {
      "id": 404030711,

      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "@chillu/@maxime-rainville fixed this in silverstripe-admin@1 with https://github.com/silverstripe/silverstripe-admin/commit/730fc42ef3e6d25345516f1583d05bf968bf762c, I've just hotfixed it in silverstripe-admin@1.2 as well with https://github.com/silverstripe/silverstripe-admin/commit/c8b18e1b197697796c0c432ff0f2c70bdfcff539\r\n\r\nThe commit message says \"This test shouldn't be in admin, since the feature is placed in framework\" - I totally agree, I've opened an issue to move it back into framework again at https://github.com/silverstripe/silverstripe-framework/issues/8256"
    }
